reviews.text: Buggy & Incomplete. This app has potential but unfortunately, it lags and seems like someone had really good ideas but gave up making the app halfway through. The visual data charts don’t work correctly. The articles aren’t readable you can’t scroll down on them. This app is easy to log & view the number of times things happen. But falls short on all these other ends and on showing my baby’s overall trends. The most important thing for me as a new mother is to see the average of times my baby is asleep in order to plan my days around it and be as productive as possible within the small times while she’s asleep.

Disappointed. Very disappointed. App crushes at least few times a day. I need to remember when I put my baby to sleep because a lot of times app stop tracking. When you’re pumping doesn’t let you log in amount of milk you pumped.. Wish I can get my money back!
Baby app. Terrible app. It works fine for a while but then stops recording so you email them but nobody gets back to you. Waste of time

Not very user friendly. I did the premium version of this app and wished I hadn’t. Not worth the cost. Inputting ounces a baby drank is a slider and it can take up to a few minutes to finally have it land on the ounces you want to input. Not very user friendly. Editing your history is a hit or Miss. Deleting an activity doesn’t even delete the one you’re on, it deletes whatever your last input is. If you go back and edit a feeding and say you want to change how many minutes she breastfeed on one side, it will end up changing the overall time you started the initial feeding session. Very frustrating. You’d be better off with Huckleberry.

Great app, but….. This app is great to track sleep, changing, and feedings, also has good articles to read for new parents. Love that. 
I wish there was a place to track bath-time and playtime though. As well as a place to write notes in, like if they spit up while feeding. Or woke up for 5 mins and went back to sleep. For $24 a year I think there should be just a little more features. 
Over all though, it’s a good app. I would recommend to new parents to track these categories.

Not worth paying.. I loved this app during my free trial. Once the subscription started and I began paying, the app timer no longer worked for feedings. I have to use the stopwatch on my phone to time it which is annoying. I paid $23 for the year, and the timer on the app uses to work great. Also, it is stuck on the “right” breast for last fed even if I mark that the left was used. So I have to remember on my own and can’t rely on the app since it won’t update. Overall, it’s a good app. But it’s not worth paying it if it’s not going to work correctly.
Initial response. It’s great so far but the articles aren’t scrolling, so I’m only reading part of the information,

Absolutely horrible - do not recommend. This app continuously closes and does not store data, I would not recommend to anyone. Customer service is also horrible and they have been 0 help in assisting with a full subscription refund. Do not waste your time with this horrible app!
Glitches more then it works. I wish I could get a refund for my subscription I got. This app didn’t work more often by a lot than the times that it did. I am finding a new app.

Needs Improvement. The app has a lot of glitches where I’ll have to force close in order for it to work or sometimes I’ll have a feeding or sleep timer going and the app will just quit and I lose that information. I don’t like that you can’t view the previous month in the history section because that’s the entire point of me recording everything for so long. There also isn’t a feature for my husband to add the app so he can edit if I’m away. It’s disappointing that I had to pay for the app before finding out this information. 
For the most part it does it’s just it just needs some fixing.
Spousal help. Love the app but would be very helpful if other parent/ spouse could be added to the app so they can log information in as well.

I have Contacted them in regard to this issue, and haven’t gotten any response. This app is not worth buying, not even downloading the free version

However aside from not being able to link the accounts the layout is lovely and very user friendly

Buyer Beware. You can’t share info with your spouse. Wish I would have known this prior to purchasing. Also, there’s another Baby Tracker app out there that this one may be trying to imitate. Not sure, but I was told from our pediatrician that the “Baby Tracker” app does allow you to share data across parents and anyone you choose.
History tracking. Since the update on 1/5/2022, I have not been able to view history beyond the date that I am currently on. I cannot see what is “yesterday” and beyond that. This is unacceptable
No history available. What is the purpose of getting this app when it does not provide the history more than 1 day?!!!! Useless!! I want the refund!
Baby Tracker Review. This app is great but it should be collaborative between parents and update go the cloud when either makes an entry.
Loving it already. This app is very helpful
Can’t See Previous Montb. It’s September 1st. And I can’t see the data/history for yesterday or anything in August! Am I missing something??

Do your research. App is alright, but don’t go straight into buying the full access. You have to average all the numbers yourself and once the 14 day free access is up it stops logging in the information. It helped me, but I wish I did my diligent research before jumping into this app.

reviews.text:
Entries and support outside of Facebook. Is there a way to edit entries in the roadmap? Currently if a mistake was made, I need to delete the entry and enter everything again. Additionally, is there an option to keep the screen on? Having my hands full, I would prefer not having to pick up the phone and unlock it to track something. 

Leaving this as a review because the App Support link takes me to a Facebook page. Do you have an email address for those who don’t use Facebook?

Stoped working. I loved this app from the start. It’s so hard for me to keep track. But it stopped working. It says it was successfully added, and no feedings or diaper changes are actually displayed.

Not registering all entries. This app is useful but has a lot of problems. Its not registering all the feeds and diapers. Sometimes I have to enter things manually multiple times. I also subscribed to the full access and it still hasn’t given me the full functionality.

Insight needs a facelift. App is good, but not great. The insight section doesn’t even tell me the total oz given in a day. It gives you averages but that’s not what I need. Am I supposed to count the total ounces myself? That’s pretty weak if you ask me. You guys should look into making this change. Everything else is good.

No shared access. I really wanted to use this app - its UI is very clean and simple unlike some of the other options which are cluttered with unnecessary elements. The show stopper was the inability to share access between two people. Seems like a huge oversight as all the other apps provide this functionality.

Glitchy and unreliable. I started using this app since the day my son was born. For the first week it worked fine but once our subscription kicked in ($23 for a year with all benefits unlocked) it either wouldn’t save entries, the time stamps for naps and feeding would be wildly different, and the app never updates so you have to close it down and reopen just to see how long it’s really been since your child ate or slept etc. with the time, say I started the timer when my son went to sleep, when I’d go to turn off the time, maybe an hour or so later, to save the amount of time he’d slept itd say a ridiculous amount. 2000 minutes plus. For $23 this is a waste of money and only causes frustration. Only reason I gave it two stars is because for the first week out of three I used it, it was fantastic.

App glitching. Your app is currently glitching despite not having a needed update. It regularly asks me to “subscribe to pro” despite me already being subscribed and currently it won’t open. I uninstalled and reinstalled. Restarted my phone. Still not working. 

It is currently 3:45am btw.

Could be way better. Logging information is messy. If you forget to stop feeding clock, then log it later but correct the time, it will post it then. No time stamps on anything. Temperature is in Celsius. 
Just not what I was needing in an app like this.
Crash. I consider myself lucky that this app crashed a couple of times before I purchased premium access.
Last Feed/Change doesn’t auto update.. Please fix this. Every time I open the app I have to tap into the last feed then go back in order for it to refresh.

Sync devices. I love the way this app looks and the fact that it covers all the bases: feeding, pooping, sleeping, pumping. However, I cannot share this with his father and his grandmother who also need to see his stats!! Is there anyway this can be added to an update? I would pay for this app if I could share it and add womb sounds, ocean waves, and rain storms to the sounds.👍🏽 other than that I loooovve this app!

App needs work!. I downloaded yesterday to track when I breastfeed, and I just unsubscribed and deleted the app. For whatever reason the feeds are only saving sometimes, which is frustrating. I’ll try a different app out!

Disappointed. Every time I use the app to keep track of how long I’m breastfeeding, it crashes and I lose track of how long I’ve been feeding. I want my money back because the only reason I have this app is for that feature. Extremely frustrating.

Needs Improvement. Very disappointed that you need a membership to access important data about your child... Also very annoying that at a certain point it stops tracking your log inputs. Is this because I didn’t buy the premium package? 

The layout of the app is quite nice though. Only app improvement I would make is display the times of the log tabs instead of “xx minutes ago”.

2 star review solely on the fact that they want you to give them your money so you can keep better track of your baby’s habits.

Unfortunately, the input was easy (though you NEED an edit feature), but the history is terrible. I recommend showing time for each event instead of just “x hours ago”. Also, the history needs to be able to go back more than a day. Im bummed to have diligently tracked everything over the last day and have nothing to speak to at the doctors today. Clean Interface. Pros: I like this app. Very clean interface. Straight to the point. 

Cons: Does not show real time - example if you fed the baby at 4:30pm it won’t show that. It will show 20 minutes ago or 2 hours ago or 19 hours ago etc. It would be nice for the app to show the actual time. Babies run on schedules and it would be extremely helpful if this feature was implemented. 

Cons: If you enter an incorrect time for example or you enter incorrect oz you cannot edit. The only option is to delete that entry and re type all the information again. It’s annoying. 

Waiting for an update will give 5 stars

Two major bugs need fixing.. 1. I own the pro account but every few days a banner will appear at the top of my screen that advertises the pro account. When this banner is present I cannot add and feeds, diaper changes, or log sleep. I can try to log it, fill in all the info but it will not show on the home page when I complete the log. I have to exit the app and restart it in order for the banner to go away and to be able to continue logging. 
2. Anytime I try to click the bell notification in the top right corner my screen goes black and the app closes. I have found no solution to aid this, it literally always closes the app down.... Every. Single. Time. 

I did not pay for the pro version for these kinds of glitches to happen. I’ve been using the app for nearly 3 months and this has not been fixed.
They lock you in.... I want to cancel my subscription and they don’t make it easy! HELP, I need to cancel!

reviews.text: Not recording feedings. Just downloaded this app and already have tried several times and can not get it to record a manually entered feeding time. Keeps going back to 0 min on both sides no matter how many times I try to enter a feeding. Pointless!! Beyond irritating

I like it, but.... I like this app, but before I could change the type of subscription I was using, I got charged for the Pro unfortunately. I wish I could call and get this refunded for the quality I am getting...

For an app that is making me pay $30/year, it would be useful if they fixed the glitches. I have been using for nearly three weeks and I STILL can’t remove the history or the app shuts down. You can only remove the last 5 “sessions”. Otherwise, it’s a nightmare for someone who is trying to accurately track. I’m so OCD and completely annoyed I have to track in my notes an entire day in case I accidentally made a mistake and have to delete half a day just to fix my one session since I don’t notice until I’m in the stats page.

Things that would drastically improve the app: 
1. I wish the app creators would allow the option to edit rather than just remove when an error is made in tracking. 
2. Fix the glitches... seriously. Why am I paying for a glitchy app? I can’t even remove an incorrect session from my history.
3. Would rather have the sessions recorded at the specified time which I have to enter rather than “45 mins ago” or “2 hours ago” as sometimes it rounds and I would rather know the actual time to plan my pump, sleep, and feed times accurately for my baby.
4. Stats for pumping for moms who are tracking how pumping is going and volume add up per day/week/etc.

Overall, this app is easy to use, however, still room for improvement to make it much more useful for detailed moms.

reviews.text:
To cancel subscription. Follow the instructions below to cancel the reoccurring subscription from your mobile device: 
1. Enter your device Settings and scroll to find iTunes & App Store 
2. Tap on your Apple ID
3. Tap on View Apple ID
4. Scroll to find Subscriptions
5. Under "Active" subscriptions, tap on Baby Tracker and Cancel Subscription

In case anyone wants to cancel their subscription prior to being charged $24 for a year of service.
